en.headline: Margarita Mile cocktail trail returns across ten Hong Kong bars from today
en.dek: The two-week event runs until 16 September; participants collect stamps for El Tequileño margaritas, with a grand prize of a trip for two to Tequila, Mexico.
body: Margarita Mile, a city-wide cocktail trail, begins today and runs until 16 September across ten participating bars, organisers said.

Guests pick up a free passport at any venue and collect a stamp for each El Tequileño margarita or cocktail ordered. Collecting five or more stamps earns a complimentary shot and entry into a secondary prize draw; completing all ten stamps enters the holder into the grand-prize draw for a trip for two to Tequila, Mexico, including flights, three nights’ accommodation and a distillery tour.

Participating venues include COA, The Old Man, The Pontiac, Dead Poets, Honky Tonks Tavern, Dragonfly and others. A closing party marking Mexican Independence Day is scheduled at Honky Tonks Tavern on 16 September.

zh.headline: Margarita Mile雞尾酒巡禮今日起於十間酒吧舉行
zh.dek: 活動由今日至9月16日，集齊印章有機會贏取雙人墨西哥Tequila之旅，包括機票及酒莊參觀。
body: 全港雞尾酒巡禮Margarita Mile今日起至9月16日在十間參與酒吧舉行，主辦單位表示。
客人可於任何一間參與酒吧免費索取護照，每點一杯El Tequileño瑪格麗特或雞尾酒可蓋印。集齊五個或以上印章可獲贈一杯烈酒及參加次獎抽獎；集齊十個印章則可參加大獎抽獎，獎品為雙人墨西哥Tequila之旅，包括來回機票、三晚住宿及酒莊參觀。
參與酒吧包括COA、The Old Man、The Pontiac、Dead Poets、Honky Tonks Tavern、Dragonfly等。9月16日將於Honky Tonks Tavern舉行墨西哥獨立日閉幕派對。
